messages:
talia: Heads up — customer SolaceTech (acct 5503) received two invoices with same invoice_id but different totals. One PDF shows USD amounts, the other shows converted EUR totals; the EUR one is missing the FX conversion fee line. Both were emailed.

greg-ops: I pulled the renderer logs. Looks like render attempt #1 completed with base USD lines and appended FX fee; attempt #2 re-rendered after a downstream currency-rate refresh and wrote a EUR-converted invoice but the fx_fee join returned empty so fee wasn't included. Both writes succeeded.

billing-bot: invoice-service: render_attempt=2 invoice_id=INV-2026-08-15-5503 status=sent duplicate_warning=true

mike-fin: This is bad — the EUR invoice total is lower because it missed the fx fee. If the customer paid the lower total we need to issue a credit for the missing fee? Or if they paid the higher total we need to ensure we don't refund incorrectly. Need to reconcile payment.

sophia-cs: Customer already replied, they paid the EUR invoice and disputes the missing fee line — wants clarification. Please prioritize.

ivan-dev: Quick hypothesis: currency-rate service refreshed mid-render; renderer retries use the new rate and mark invoice as EUR when account preference is EUR, but the fx_fee is populated from fx_fee_subledger which is generated by a separate batch that hadn't finished for the new rate. Retry path didn't wait for subledger. No idempotent guard either.

greg-ops: SQL to inspect subledger join:
```
SELECT i.invoice_id, i.currency, s.fee_cents, r.attempt
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN fx_fee_subledger s ON s.account_id = i.account_id AND s.batch_id = i.batch_id
JOIN invoice_renders r ON r.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE i.account_id = 5503 AND i.batch_date = '2026-08-15';
```

talia: payment check: payment_id=pay_e9a processed at 11:36 UTC, matches the EUR PDF timestamp (the lower total). We need to issue a credit memo for the missing fee and send a clear explanation. Finance approval?

mike-fin: Approve credit memo for the missing FX fee + processing fee coverage. Finance requests a short CS note template before sending.

sophia-cs: I'll draft and send once credit memo number is available. Please CC cs@redwood.

ivan-dev: Proposed remediation: 1) make renderer verify required subledgers exist for chosen currency before committing invoice write; 2) add idempotency check to avoid multiple invoice rows for same invoice_id, 3) backfill fx_fee_subledger for any affected invoices and re-render with --ensure-subledgers flag. I'll open a PR for the verification guard.

greg-ops: I'll queue a manual backfill for acct 5503 and then re-render the invoice with `--ensure-subledgers`. Also will mark the duplicate PDF as retracted in S3 to avoid confusion.

billing-bot: manual-backfill queued: job=fx-backfill-5503 requested_by=greg-ops ETA=3m

billing-bot: manual-regenerate queued: job=regen-2026-08-15-5503 requested_by=greg-ops ETA=4m

greg-ops: Backfill completed; fx_fee_subledger now populated. Regeneration in progress.

billing-bot: regen completed: job=regen-2026-08-15-5503 status=completed results: invoice corrected, credit_memo=CM-2026-08-15-5503 amount=250 cents processed=true pdfs_replaced=true

mike-fin: Confirmed credit memo issued for missing FX fee (250 cents) and processing fee covered. Finance ledger updated.

sophia-cs: Customer notified with apology and explanation. They acknowledged and accepted the credit. Closing loop.

ivan-dev: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/4781 — adds subledger existence check and idempotency guard. Also adding an integration test for mid-rate-refresh renders.

talia: Filing FIN-INV-412 for postmortem and adding a smoke check to detect multiple PDFs for same invoice_id with different currencies.

greg-ops: Will monitor renderer retry telemetry and subledger lag metric. Closing thread.
